notes.title: Stand By Me September 2025 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p align="start"]This month's update is a little late because I was finishing up some IRL-work related things, but better late than never :)[/p][p align="start"]Stand By Me is continuing to get new maps to fit its new look, and we are excited to share some of them with you! [/p][p align="start"]Here is Ciel on a little stroll on the road from the shopping district to the Rozenbleu mansion. Make sure to switch on the sound to have  a preview of the beautiful new BGM created just for Desideria, by the talented [url="https://x.com/damahysk"]dama[/url]! The NPC sprites are still pending changes though![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ac8c889D4PQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p align="start"]Also, now that things are finalised, we wanted to reveal more about the composers of our custom soundtrack. We are beyond excited to announce that we will be collaborating with 2 talented composers to bring the world of Stand By Me to life.[/p][p align="start"]As aforementioned, the talented Japanese composer [url="https://x.com/damahysk"]Dama[/url] will be working on tracks relating to our game's settings and locations, to bring the overworld to life. After listening to a few tracks that he's already produced for our game, we have no doubt that his mastery over a range of different music styles makes him a great fit for our project.[/p][p align="start"]Our main theme, character themes, and emotional BGMs will be handed by [url="https://vgmdb.net/artist/25602"]Kimiyoshi Maruyama[/url] of Project Lights, who worked on the BGM for well-known otome projects like Steam Prison and Ozmafia! We are delighted that they kindly agreed to work with us despite being a small indie studio, and are looking forward to listening to the tracks which are now in production![/p][p align="start"]We hope that you guys are as excited as we are! We will reveal more in next month's update. [/p][p align="start"]Thank you so much for the support![/p][p align="start"]With Love, [/p][p align="start"]fishattic games[/p]

notes.title: Stand By Me August 2025 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're back with our monthly update, this time for August 2025![/p][p][/p][p]Today, we will properly share some of the new maps for our game, created by our lovely pixel artist, fissh. The maps have, of course, been reworked to fit the new resolution of 1104 x 624 px. We're so happy that we can add more stuff that has actual lore significance to our game, making the exploration process genuinely meaningful and educational! We'll be putting much more care in the interactions with objects in the game to supplement our stat raising system.[/p][p][/p][p]Ciel's Room[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/05f084b1fb63efdb2dff55a893a017c9622a0536.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/6bb11ec522fad0f73e707776c6a38f46d5ffa685.png"][/img][/p][p]Mansion Library[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/7a3774906c1e1924f01fd26fca94d0892e9d8ed0.png"][/img][/p][p]Mansion Entrance [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/919b432b98914eed5c77634b33a123cc95bb56c7.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, PS we've heard your feedback about "why can't she go upstairs in her own house", now there's a small new area to explore![/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now :) Love you all![/p][p]fishattic games <3[/p]

notes.title: Stand By Me July 2025 Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]It's been one month since the end of our Kickstarter. Even though it didn't work out, we are even more motivated to give the people who believed in us a better and more fun gameplay experience![/p][p]As promised, we will try to update on our progress every month, so this is our[b] July update[/b]!!![/p][p]The biggest thing we are currently working on is i[b]ncreasing the resolution of our game to a HD full screen[/b] (as compared to its windowed form previously). Of course, this requires a lot of assets adjustment but we believe it is definitely worth it (including some CG redraws as well).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/ec189a256d193d92576981d7576adcfc16743058.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, we've added the much requested [b]numerical values [/b]for Social Stats and Affection menus. What's more, the Affection Menu is even clickable now! It even has fancy entrance/exit animations :) [/p][p][/p][p]The gifs aren't very HQ, sorry about that...[/p][p][b]Social Stats [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/3e38c3b62826a730fa1e47aa75473adac572e377.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Affection Menu[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/101dc7c4cfce2fb24b310cda137450826490dd53.gif"][/img][/p][p]it's not very apparent in this GIF, but the hearts show the affection value, which will stand out more when the hearts are filled![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/e142064dc0b267500727717d9a2af635c84977b5.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also received the first new map and first 2 new BGMs - we'll showcase them properly later but the quality is already much better than before and it's so exciting![/p][p]Thank you for everyone's continued support of our project and we look forward to sharing more next month ^^[/p][p][/p][p]Love, [/p][p]fishattic games[/p]

notes.title: 20 May Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello all, we've fixed an issue with the previous version where there was an issue with the castle library scene. Special thanks to nonbiriotome for bringing this up to us!

We're sorry for the inconvenience and please make sure to update your game!

Love, fishattic

notes.title: Stand By Me Demo Patch Notes: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you to everyone who reviewed, streamed, and gave feedback on areas of improvement for our game! 

Special thanks to Silver for their early feedback on a game-breaking bug (previously fixed), DALilly for their [url=https://youtu.be/g4ng-mKJNh0?si=uRJmpfwnfV_Gp0DN]stream[/url], which we used to catch many of these; Itchio user Manedza for their detailed review (with screenshots of the bugs); and Amjara from OtomeLovers for their comprehensive [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198018894642/recommended/3665280/]Steam review[/url]!

We're pleased to inform you guys that we've gone on a bug squashing spree this weekend, and whichever issues that were caught should now be resolved. The details on the fixes are as described below ^^

[u][b]Technical errors
[/b][/u]
1. Accessibility issues fixed - briefing room, forest, church etc. Please note that we may not have caught all of them exhaustively, but rest assured we'll fix them as they are highlighted!
2, Some issues with Ciel's portrait being broken/missing have been fixed
3.  Minor text/dialogue issues, such as spelling errors and wrong events.
[u][b]
UI improvements[/b][/u]
1. Menu UI adjustment - we received feedback that the menu icons were too small, character busts too big, and there should be a dark overlay to make it stand out more. These have been adjusted!
2. Journal UI adjustment - increased opacity and adjusted font colors


Before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/b736632573e5f9d39409cf1c4a80bc4192c784f1.jpg[/img]
Credits to Amjara for this feedback image!

After:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/a074f1bda10951a410ab5f6f98f3fcb9cebfb6a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583957/4e02b248b301db8c08cc09dacca622c1aa55042e.png[/img]

In other news, we are now 32% funded on Kickstarter with 70 backers! We can't thank you all enough for your support. If you enjoyed the game and you'd like to support us, you can back us on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fishattic/stand-by-me]Kickstarter[/url], or simply leave a review or rating of our game and wishlist our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623370/Stand_By_Me_Otome_Isekai_RPG/]main page[/url]. Every little bit counts! 

If you've read up till here, thank you so much for your attention, and happy playing!

Best, 
fish☆attic games
